category: Russian ruble reseller of Turbobit Turbo codes

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a code, not an object

retention.stated: The code is valid for the term bought (7 days, or 6 months); the traffic figure in the same line is the reseller's own packaging and is not explained
retention.notes: The '7200 GB' next to '6 месяцев' is printed by the reseller without saying whether it is a traffic cap or a marketing bundle.

egress.terms: Sold as a Turbo code; any traffic cap is Turbobit's and is not restated

interface_detail: A forum-style order page: choose a payment method, enter the amount, pay, receive the code by email ('на следующем этапе введите email, на который будет отправлен код').
tooling: Browser plus YooMoney. The code is then activated at turbobit.net.
chaining: The ruble rail for a client who has a Russian wallet but no foreign card: it turns RUB into the same Turbo access that turbobitpremium.org sells for USD.

limits.value: 6 months / 7200 GB at RUB 2,600-2,860 - about 1.2 TB per month if the GB figure is a cap

limits_note: The forum posts are user reports, not a tariff table; the two terms quoted (RUB 500 for 7 days/300 GB, RUB 2,600-2,860 for 6 months/7,200 GB) are what buyers posted.
binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the 7,200 GB over six months is about 1.2 TB/month, so the bundled GB figure is the ceiling if it is enforced. The reseller does not say whether it is.

identity_cost.detail: An email address for the code plus a YooMoney wallet; no account on the reseller is required.

reliability_note: The reseller's price and stock are user-posted on its own news thread, not a tariff page; one poster reports paying RUB 2,860 instead of the listed RUB 2,600, and another reports the 7-day code as '500 руб' in 2023.
confidence_note: The RUB figures and the YooMoney rail come from buyer posts dated 2023-07-23 and 2026-01-14 on the reseller's thread; the seller itself is not the source of a tariff. A direct order would raise this to documented. Evidence dates normalised to the read date on 2026-10-23; a source that carries its own date keeps it in the proved field.

evidence.proved: '6 месяцев - 7200 GB - 2600 руб - 2860 руб. Только-что оплатил через Ю-мани' (buyer report, 2026-01-14)
'премиум на турбобит...7 дней 300 GB 500 руб' and that the code arrived within eight minutes

price_per_tb_month: RUB 2,860 per 6 months for 7,200 GB (about RUB 477/month) at the 2026-01-14 report
notes: This is the clearest example of a service closed to a foreigner by its payment rail: YooMoney only, rubles only. It is also the price a Russian actually pays, which is higher per month than the USD reseller at long terms and lower at short ones.
